endpoints.summary: Get a user profile by id

findings.title: Excessive Data Exposure on /users/me
findings.impact: The response exposes fields the client should not receive: creditScore, internalNotes, passwordHash, token. Credential/cryptographic material is among them. These are returned to any caller who can reach the endpoint.
findings.remediation: Return an explicit response DTO containing only the documented fields. Never serialize the internal model directly.

findings.actual: Response includes sensitive/undocumented fields: creditScore, internalNotes, passwordHash, token

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization on /orders/{order_id}
findings.impact: Authenticated user 'userA' retrieved private resource #102 owned by 'userB'. The server returned the full object without checking caller ownership.
findings.remediation: Enforce a resource-level ownership check: before returning /orders/{order_id}, confirm the object's owner id equals the authenticated user id (or the caller holds an authorized role).

findings.title: Broken Authentication on /invoices
findings.impact: The specification marks GET /invoices as requiring authentication, but an anonymous request returned data. Anyone on the network can read it.
findings.remediation: Enforce the declared security scheme in middleware; reject requests without a valid token.

findings.title: Broken Function Level Authorization on /admin/users
findings.impact: Low-privilege user 'userA' invoked the admin-scoped function GET /admin/users and received a success response. Administrative capability is exposed to non-admins.
findings.remediation: Enforce a role check on this endpoint (e.g. require role == 'admin') before executing the handler, not merely in the UI.

findings.title: Missing Rate Limiting on /auth/login
findings.impact: 20 sequential failed logins were accepted with no throttling, lockout, or rate-limit headers. This enables credential-stuffing and brute-force attacks.
findings.remediation: Add per-IP and per-account rate limiting with lockout/backoff on the auth endpoint.

findings.title: Security misconfiguration (headers / CORS / version disclosure)
findings.impact: missing headers: x-content-type-options, x-frame-options; version disclosure (uvicorn). These weaken defence-in-depth and enable cross-origin credential theft.
findings.remediation: Add X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options and HSTS; restrict CORS to an allowlist and never reflect an arbitrary Origin with credentials; suppress Server/X-Powered-By.

summary.text: SentinelAPI confirmed 6 findings across the SentinelShop API, including a Critical BOLA that lets one customer read another's order. Each finding is backed by real HTTP evidence and a reproducible PoC.
